newsitem.title: USA: Seitel unit adds to gas/oil reserves in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Seitel unit adds to gas/oil reserves in Q2.

text.p: Seitel Inc, reporting a rising quarterly operating and net income, said Thursday its DDD energy unit added 15 billion cubic feet equivalent (bcfe) of gas, oil and liquids to its proved reserves in the second quarter ended June 30.
Seitel said the unit's proved reserves now total 47 percent of the 44.7 bcfe it had at the end of 1996.

"We expect additional significant reserve additions during the second half, because we have received strong indications from a number of wells related to 'impact plays' that are currently drilling," said Seitel's chief operating officer Horace Calvert in a statement.

"DDD Energy's revenue stream should also accelerate this half as new wells recently completed begin flowing to sales and several key wells, which went off line temporarily during the second quarter for processing-plant turnaround, are now back on line," Calvert added.

Seitel Thursday posted a net income of $5.4 million, or $0.49 a share, in the second quarter, compared with a $3.2 million net, or $0.31 a share, in the 1996 quarter. Income from continuing operations rose 30 percent to $5.4 million from $4.2 million a year ago.

Seitel's quarterly revenues rose 28 percent to $34.7 million from $27.2 million in the 1996 quarter. Seismic revenues rose 25 percent to $29.3 million from 23.4 million in 1996. The company's DDD Energy unit's revenues soared 42 percent to $5.3 million from $3.8 million in the 1996 quarter.
The company's stock closed at 40-9/16 Wednesday.
